name: Biceps curl
summary: Dumbbell hanging, curl it to the shoulder with the elbow pinned to the side, lower slowly.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, working arm nearest, dumbbell hanging with the palm forward. Curl to the shoulder without the elbow moving, then lower slowly to straight.
brief: Stand with the dumbbell hanging, palm forward. Curl to the shoulder without letting the elbow move, then lower slowly to straight.
why: From the side the elbow angle gives each curl, and the upper arm swinging forward — the usual cheat — shows as the shoulder–elbow line leaving vertical.
regression: Lighter; seated with the back supported.
contraindications: Elbow or wrist pain under load.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Elbows drifting forward
faults.tip: When the elbow travels forward the front of the shoulder is lifting the weight.

faults.label: Not straightening fully
faults.tip: Each rep starts from a straight arm.

faults.label: Curling the wrists
faults.tip: A bent wrist under load is a common source of forearm pain.

points.t: Pinned to the side; bends fully and straightens fully.
